name: EPIC 206086431

text.card: A red giant 3,062 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.74 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,904 K at its surface.
